0022600134.text: The Pistons (3-1, first in the Central and in the East) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-1, first in the Southeast and third in the East) in Detroit's fifth game of the season. Detroit has won three of its last four and is coming off a loss, while Charlotte has won its last two games. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise), Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ausar Thompson, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 118-100 win in Charlotte on April 10, 2026.
